race.comment: MAKAMAE (8) has been knocking on the door of another victory with consecutive runner-up finishes and strikes a very winnable contest here. Is a two-time winner around this circuit and should be right there when the whips are cracking. KING COBAMA (2) has been well in the betting at the past couple of outings and where there's smoke there's fire. Will give backers a sight. PECCAVI (9) strips fitter second-up from the break and trust that Waller has her ready to peak now. Top-three candidate. FIERY LASS (10) saves her best form for this track and gets in light with the claim. Watch for a spike in form. ENCOURAGED (1) best of the rest.
